comfyui.description: Create images and videos from your ideas.
comfyui.name: ComfyUI (Image + Video Generation)

decisions.description: Choose among a set of options.
decisions.name: Local decisions
decisions.note: On-demand CPU decision service (observed about 2.9 GiB RSS for narrow readouts, up to 5.84 GiB for 255-option full-vocab readout); configurable CUDA placement with CPU startup fallback.

decisions-quality.description: Evaluate a set of options for a careful choice.
decisions-quality.name: Local quality decisions
decisions-quality.note: Opt-in CPU decision service (4B memory budget is unmeasured; unit starts at 10G); exits after 10 minutes idle.

embeddings.description: Represent text for semantic search and comparison.

models.description: Represent text for semantic search and comparison.

embeddings.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5 CPU
embeddings.note: CPU-only llama-server embedding backend; no GPU budget claim.

kobold.description: Chat, write, reason, and work with code.

models.description: Chat, reason, and ask questions about images.
Get quick answers and help with everyday tasks.
Chat with the currently selected model.
Get quick answers from the currently selected model.
Create characters and explore fictional conversations.

kobold.name: Local llama.cpp server (official; Bee rollback available)

realtime.name: speech-to-speech
realtime.note: OpenAI Realtime (WebSocket) served by Hugging Face speech-to-speech on CPU (Silero VAD, Smart Turn). Its STT, LLM and TTS slots call this gateway's own routes. Started by the gateway lifecycle driver; the gateway relays /v1/realtime to it.

rerank.description: Rank search results by relevance to your question.
rerank.name: rerank-cpu
rerank.note: On-demand CPU reranker (llama-server --rerank, Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B); about 1 GB RAM while running, exits after 10 min idle, started by the gateway lifecycle driver. Never a GPU.

stt-canary.name: canary-stt
stt-canary.note: On-demand audio.cpp Canary 180M Flash ASR on GPU0; started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

stt-diarize.description: Transcribe audio and identify different speakers.
stt-diarize.name: diarize-stt
stt-diarize.note: On-demand CPU diarization (Nemotron 3 Diarization) plus Parakeet words, gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize shape; started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

stt-nemotron.name: nemotron-stt
stt-nemotron.note: audio.cpp Nemotron 3.5 streaming ASR on GPU0, the realtime speech-to-text engine; always warm: starts at boot, keeps its model loaded and never unloads it when idle. The gateway lifecycle driver starts it only if it was stopped.

stt-parakeet-gpu.description: Quickly turn recorded speech into text.
stt-parakeet-gpu.name: parakeet-gpu-stt
stt-parakeet-gpu.note: On-demand audio.cpp Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (q8) on GPU0: CPU-Parakeet accuracy at 5-9x the speed; weights unload after 5 min idle; started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

tts.description: Turn text into speech with a consistent voice.
tts.name: omnivoice-tts
tts.note: OmniVoice, the fallback speech engine; on demand: exits after 5 min idle (frees 2-4 GB of GPU0, more after long texts), started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

tts-chatterbox.description: Create speech using a reference voice.
tts-chatterbox.name: chatterbox-tts
tts-chatterbox.note: Chatterbox Turbo (Python) voice-cloning TTS on GPU0. Temporarily disabled since 2026-10-08 to free GPU0 memory for the desktop; the unit is stopped. When enabled again it is on demand, keeps its weights loaded while running (no idle unload or exit), and is started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

tts-kokoro.description: Read text aloud with a choice of voices.
tts-kokoro.name: kokoro-tts
tts-kokoro.note: On-demand Kokoro-82M Python TTS on GPU0; exits after 10 min idle; started by the gateway lifecycle driver.

tts-supertonic.description: Turn text into speech with preset voices.
tts-supertonic.name: supertonic-tts
tts-supertonic.note: audio.cpp Supertonic realtime TTS on GPU0, the default speech engine; always warm: starts at boot, keeps its model loaded and never unloads it when idle. The gateway lifecycle driver starts it only if it was stopped.
